title: News Text Summarization using Deep Learning
shortDescription: Summarizes news articles with Keras/TensorFlow trained on the CNN/DailyMail dataset.

details.overview: A full‑stack application that allows users to paste a news article and generate an abstractive summary using a Seq2Seq model trained with Keras/TensorFlow. The backend is built in Django with an inference API, and the frontend is in React.
features: Paste article or upload file to summarize
GPU-accelerated model inference endpoint
History of generated summaries

title: Search Engine for Past Papers (FAST NUCES)
shortDescription: Academic search over past papers using information retrieval techniques and embeddings.

features: Tokenization, stemming and TF‑IDF scoring
Semantic reranking with transformer embeddings
Faceted filtering by subject and year

title: E‑Pharmacy (Online medicine store)
shortDescription: E‑commerce app to browse, search and purchase medicines with cart and checkout.

details.overview: A MERN‑style application (Node + React + MySQL) for discovering medicines, placing orders, and managing inventory.
features: JWT authentication and user roles
Shopping cart and order management
Admin dashboard for products

title: TimeLeft – Countdown & Reminder Utility
shortDescription: Versatile desktop utility — countdown clock, reminder, clock, alarm clock, tray clock, stopwatch, timer, sticker, auction watch and time synchronization. Also available as a mobile app.

details.overview: A feature‑rich time management utility for Windows that provides countdowns, reminders, clocks, timers, stopwatch, sticky notes, tray clock and time synchronization, with customizable floating windows and skins. Also available as a mobile app for time visualization on the go.
features: Powerful customizable reminders with one‑time and recurring schedules
Countdown for web export and desktop floating countdowns
Time synchronization using atomic clock servers
Tray clock with skins and multi‑time‑zone clock
Stopwatch and timer modules
Stickers (sticky notes) on desktop
Working days/hours countdown
Floating windows with zoom and skins
Auction Watch to monitor online auctions

title: Stickball – Life Skills & Financial Education
shortDescription: Programs for K‑12, college, communities and corporations focused on financial literacy, life skills and analytical certifications; also full‑stack development services.

details.overview: An education and empowerment platform delivering engaging life skills, financial literacy and analytical certification programs for K‑12, college students, communities and corporates, with tech‑driven, customizable offerings and in‑house full‑stack development services.
features: K‑12 programs emphasizing creativity, critical thinking, communication and collaboration
College programs in financial literacy, leadership development and emotional intelligence
Community empowerment initiatives and partnerships
Corporate training with tailored solutions
Full‑stack development services for digital products

title: Hummingbird – Self‑Storage Property Management Software
shortDescription: Cloud‑based PMS that automates busywork, streamlines front‑desk workflows, and drives revenue for self‑storage operators.

details.overview: Modern, cloud‑native property management software for self‑storage operators that automates repetitive tasks (reminders, notices, reporting), empowers front‑desk teams with an intuitive UI, unifies operational and marketing data to reveal what drives occupancy, and bakes compliance into core workflows.
features: Automation for reminders, notices, and reporting
Intuitive operator‑designed UI for front‑desk efficiency
Unified data across website, PMS, and reputation analytics
Built‑in compliance for leases and lien processes
